title: PVC vs. ABS in DWV Drainage Systems
description: Selecting between Schedule 40 PVC and ABS pipes depends on specific job requirements and local building code approvals. White PVC offers high structural rigidity, excellent chemical resistance, and requires a two-step solvent welding process using primer and solvent cement. Black ABS is highly impact-resistant at lower temperatures and utilizes a single-step solvent cement process. Mixing these materials directly requires specialized transition fittings or approved transition cement. Always check temperature limitations, expansion rates, and local code mandates before selecting your drainage material.

Black ABS is highly impact-resistant at lower temperatures and utilizes a single-step solvent cement process. Always check temperature limitations, expansion rates, and local code mandates before selecting your drainage material.
